en: Lets {n} residents be fed from the common stock
zh: 使{n}名居民可由公共储备供养

en: the camp expects goods worth at least {n} credit for {years} years
zh: 营地期望{years}年内至少有价值{n}信用的货物

en: {a} does not convert into {b}; build it new
upgrade between 1 and {n} level(s) of {name} here
Upgrade ordered: {n} level(s) stand idle until they reopen as {name}, at least {m} months.
zh: 已下令升级：{n}级停工，直到作为{name}重新开放，至少{m}个月。

en: generation {tier} is obsolete: generation {next} ({name}) can be fitted out
zh: 第{tier}代已过时：可改装为第{next}代（{name}）

en: Our forces lost {a}; the raiders lost about {b}.
zh: 我军损失{a}；劫掠者损失约{b}。

en: After {progress} months of control, {ln} administers {rname}. Its people, debts and damaged works come with it; cooperation does not.
zh: 经过{progress}个月的控制，{ln}治理{rname}。其人民、债务和受损的设施随之而来；合作则不然。

en: Farmland lost to the city at {name}
{lost} level(s) of fields gave way to streets and works. Housing saves land.
zh: {lost}级农田让位给了街道和工场。住房建设可以节约土地。

en: The camp of {name} is broken; its {n} survivors are now our subjects and the land is ours to govern.
zh: {name}的营地已被攻破；其{n}名幸存者现已成为我们的臣民，土地由我们治理。

en: The camp of {name} is broken and its plunder recovered. The land is free to settle.
zh: {name}的营地已被攻破，赃物已追回。这片土地可以自由定居了。
来自{rname}的劫掠者被赶走了。

en: Raiders from {rname} carried off stores and killed {n}. Garrison the region or clear their camp.
zh: 来自{rname}的劫掠者抢走了存粮并杀死{n}人。请驻军守卫该地区，或清剿其营地。
